title: Spellglass spell pack, format spellpack/0 (legacy)
description: The pre-release spell pack format, from before contract 1.0. Nothing ships in it any more; Spellglass still reads it so the migration chain is real and tested (Section 9.1 rule 4, Section 13 'Legacy packs'; TypeScript shape in src/contracts/packs.ts SpellPackV0). Differences from spellpack/1: the pack has 'name' instead of 'title' and no 'engine' or 'needs'; each spell has 'words' instead of 'incantation', 'shape' instead of 'gesture', and 'effect' is a bare list of steps with no fallback. Migration to spellpack/1 (src/kernel/packs/migrate.ts) renames name to title, words to incantation and shape to gesture, wraps the step list as { steps, fallback: 'sparkle' }, sets engine to '>=1.0 <2.0' and sets needs to the capabilities of the steps the pack uses. Unknown fields are kept. Stored files are never rewritten; the migration runs every time the pack loads.
